integrity: Proof and two standalone Python verification scripts included; no independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The equivalence is restricted to coherently oriented simple cycles of length at least three and quantifier rank at most two; higher ranks and arbitrary digraphs are not covered. Finite checks support, but do not replace, the all-size proof. Priority risk remains for potentially unindexed specialized literature.
title: Orientation-erasure equivalence for rank-two logic on binary cycles
